roadmap_revision.reason: A6 was split before execution; A6a was split because the signed A5 APK predates D4a/D4b; A6a2 is split again because fully automatic no-routine-ADB verification spans native self-check, browser DAL/fallback evidence, PWA correlation, signed rebuild, and real-device acceptance and cannot reliably fit inside one 18-minute checkpoint.
roadmap_revision.a6a1: rebuild and cryptographically verify the current signed release candidate
roadmap_revision.a6a2b: browser Digital Asset Links relationship validation plus observable Custom Tab fallback
roadmap_revision.a6a2c: automatic PWA launch handshake, Supabase correlation, and deterministic verdict rules
roadmap_revision.a6a2e: real-device automatic acceptance from Supabase evidence; routine path requires no ADB
roadmap_revision.automatic_verification_policy: Normal A6a2 path must not require user-run ADB or screenshots. Public Android/browser evidence is evaluated first. Callback timeout/unknown is INCONCLUSIVE, never guessed. ADB is a last-resort fallback only after automatic evidence is exhausted.
roadmap_revision.privacy_rule: Use synthetic/non-sensitive test data only; probe IDs must be random technical IDs with no user data; keep signing key/password outside Git and logs; diagnostics collect technical metadata only.

source.equivalence: GitHub compare from validation head to main shows only PROJECT_STATE.json changed; Android/product source used by the release artifact did not drift.

signing.identity: Matches the existing A4 release certificate fingerprint published in Digital Asset Links.
signing.secret_handling: Private keystore/password were used only from the existing private signing backup outside Git and were not written to repository files or diagnostic logs.

reliability_changes.native: Automatic native self-check/TWA evidence is persisted before transport in a bounded local outbox, retried with bounded delays, retained for the next launch after transport failure, and preserves its original probe ID across later launches.
reliability_changes.pwa: Diagnostic uploads are serialized rather than dropped while another upload is in flight; automatic launch/startup reports retry; pwa_startup_no_probe distinguishes a live PWA from a missing native handshake.
reliability_changes.service_worker: Cache generation bumped from linkpas-pwa-v5 to linkpas-pwa-v6 so the repaired diagnostics bundle replaces stale cached diagnostics code once the next production web deployment is permitted.
reliability_changes.privacy: No affiliate-link content, clipboard content, buyer email, license value, credentials, signing material, screenshots, file contents, or device identifier was added to diagnostics.
